facts.business: LT Foods is a global FMCG company in the consumer food sector with a fully integrated 'Farm to Fork' value chain, specializing in basmati rice, organic staples, ready-to-cook solutions, and contemporary snacking formats across 85+ countries.
facts.related_party_note: The Company follows a transparent governance framework for managing potential conflicts of interest. All financial and commercial transactions in which Directors or Promoters may have a direct or indirect interest are fully disclosed to the Board for review and consideration. Interested Directors do not participate in discussions related to such matters and abstain from voting on resolutions concerning those transactions.
